mission_check.reusable_capability: Construct model-owned move-choice practice for any of Red's 151 species with both combatants' moves, PP, levels and coherent battle stats
mission_check.learned_authority: The actor sees semantic battle observations and can only choose controller actions; cartridge edits remain teacher-only setup
mission_check.transfer_test: Require a prospectively varied train curriculum and disjoint untouched natural development battles before any promotion; no transfer result here
mission_check.cheapest_falsifier: A cartridge-derived species or moveset fails exact readback or a generated real battle fails to execute
mission_check.time_box: One implementation session and one four-candidate real-cartridge qualification
mission_check.stop_condition: Stop on incoherent state, unexecutable moves, synthetic-root independence claim, model fit, full run or GitHub publication

limitations: One generated configuration and one RNG timing share a consumed train root; they do not establish model improvement or independent coverage
The catalog distinguishes intrinsic and TM/HM-compatible moves, but trainer-requested custom movesets are allowed and must be labeled assisted, not naturally legal
Evolution-inherited and event-only moves are not claimed by the current availability API
Status, items, multi-member teams, switching and trainer AI remain unsupported
